contracts.product_freshness: Worker re-fetches the full entity list during the daily vendor-profile rebuild and attaches stem-joined rows to matching profiles. Schema probes tolerate multi-month publisher lag via max_stale_days.
contracts.used_for: Vendor identity enrichment on vendor profiles: Doing Business Search listing, ownership structure, organization phone, and doing-business start date when organization_name stems match a City Record award vendor.

join_measurement.universe_modern_awards: City Record Online (dg92-zbpx) Procurement Award notices with non-empty vendor_name and start_date >= 2025-01-01
join_measurement.universe_historical_awards: Same notice type with start_date in [2016-01-01, 2025-01-01)
join_measurement.strategy: vendor_stem (product vendorStem on organization_name equals vendorStem(vendor_name)). Substring/token-overlap and phone-only joins rejected.
join_measurement.verdict: Above usefulness threshold (>=30%) on modern awards (70.42% notice-level stem join; 61.62% distinct-vendor stem join). Ship join + edge materialization onto vendor profiles.

contracts.owner: NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services
contracts.publisher_cadence: Weekly
contracts.product_freshness: The Worker refreshes the bounded fleet sidecar daily with the Property materialization; the committed snapshot remains a build-time fallback. An eight-day age check labels older data as latest-known, not current.
contracts.used_for: Official fleet-auction inventory leading the Property open-now surface. Rows are excluded from parcel chains, BBL joins, map counts, parcel exports, and City Record saved-watch claims.

contracts.name: ULURP Recommendations (Borough President positions)
contracts.owner: Brooklyn Borough President / NYC Open Data
contracts.publisher_cadence: Historical / irregular Brooklyn Borough President recommendations (resource Last-Modified 2021-06-29; 91 rows)
contracts.product_freshness: Disabled for product reads. Schema probes tolerate multi-year freeze via max_stale_days because the publication is intentionally historical and borough-scoped.
contracts.used_for: No current product output. Ranked land-outcome depth candidate was measured; strict ULURP-number join usefulness is below the materialization threshold.
contracts.gap: Strict ULURP-token joins from ZAP projects with non-null ulurp_numbers cover 0.54% when combined with the PDF companion (gt5i-dmde) and 0.29% for this table alone (81/27,971) — both below the ~30% usefulness threshold. The catalog is Brooklyn Borough President history (91 rows), not a citywide live feed. Property Disposition notices are the wrong universe for this join. Borough President / community board recommendation letters remain not-yet-ingested on the land path until a higher-coverage source ships or usefulness is re-measured above threshold.

join_measurement.universe: NYC Open Data ZAP projects (hgx4-8ukb) with non-null ulurp_numbers
join_measurement.strategy: exact_ulurp_token (optional type letter + 6-digit body + letter suffix; spaces optional). Bare body without suffix, title-only, and Property Disposition notice sampling rejected.
join_measurement.verdict: Below usefulness threshold (~30%) on ZAP projects with non-null ulurp_numbers (0.54% either recommendations or PDFs). Ship measured reconnaissance + disabled source contracts only; do not edge-materialize Borough President recommendation panels. Keep the class-(a) land-outcome pointer.
